description: Creates a private home, office or building cleaning enquiry to Sauber mit Sam (Samiha Aktaa) at office@sauber-mit-sam.at in Vienna (1010–1230), and queues a business email. Requires explicit customer authorisation for the exact details, named recipient and current privacy version. Free enquiry; no booking, quote, payment, public posting or contact resale. Production accepts real customer enquiries only. A new random 16–100 character idempotency key identifies the enquiry; identical retries return the same receipt, changed input under the same key is rejected. Returns only a receipt, never customer data or credentials.

address.description: Private address relevant to the authorised service enquiry; never invent missing address details.
address.title: Address

email.description: Customer-approved reply email address. At least one valid email or phone number is required.
email.title: Email

name.description: Name of the customer or authorised contact; private, not for public search previews.
name.title: Name

phone.description: Customer-approved contact phone number. At least one valid email or phone number is required.
phone.title: Phone

idempotency_key.description: New random 16–100 character key for this enquiry. Reuse only for an identical retry; changed details need a new key and renewed customer approval.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

payload.description: Exact private cleaning enquiry approved by the customer for Sauber mit Sam, including Sam-specific consent and current privacy version.

acknowledged_privacy_version.description: Current Sam privacy version returned by direct_cleaning_inquiry_options and actually acknowledged by the customer.
acknowledged_privacy_version.title: Acknowledged Privacy Version

authority_to_request.description: Set true only after confirming the customer's authority to request the cleaning.
authority_to_request.title: Authority To Request

consent_to_send_to_sam.description: Set true only after explicit customer approval to send these exact details to Sauber mit Sam; L&G consent cannot be reused.
consent_to_send_to_sam.title: Consent To Send To Sam

contact.description: Private customer contact and service address approved for this enquiry to Sam.

country.description: Service country; the current direct cleaning pilot accepts only Austria (AT).
country.title: Country

description.title: Description

postal_code.title: Postal Code

preferred_time.description: Customer's preferred cleaning time or recurring schedule; no appointment is reserved by submission.

recipient.title: Recipient

service.title: Service

understands_not_a_booking_or_quote.description: Confirm the customer understands this submission is an enquiry, not a booking, quote or price agreement.
understands_not_a_booking_or_quote.title: Understands Not A Booking Or Quote
